document.title: [Bug]: DeepSeek-V4.1 DSpark adaptive verification + FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: illegal memory access under concurrent prefill (FlashInfer sparse DSV41 builders declare ALWAYS)
document.body:
### Your current environment

`vllm/vllm-openai:v0.31.0` (digest `sha256:a4a4c0437bf7…`), 2× B300 (SM103), TP2, Model Runner V2, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (rev `dba1be0a40aa45a94ad051997016db3960a90277`).

### 🐛 Describe the bug

With DSpark adaptive verification on and `cudagraph_mode=FULL_AND_PIECEWISE`, the engine dies with `CUDA error: an illegal memory access was encountered` once the scheduler runs mixed prefill+decode batches at high concurrency. The error surfaces at the event sync in `AdaptiveVerification.record_confidences` (`vllm/v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode/adaptive_verification.py:264`, called from `model_runner.sample_tokens`). Because the error is async, that frame is only where it is reported.

Serve command (relevant flags):

```
vllm serve deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash --tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 -tp 2 \
  --max-model-len 1040000 --max-num-seqs 128 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --long-prefill-token-threshold 4096 \
  --enable-prefix-caching --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true}' \
  --attention-config '{"backend":"FLASHINFER_MLA_SPARSE_DSV41","indexer_kv_dtype":"mxfp4","indexer_sparse_logits":true}' \
  --compilation-config '{"mode":"VLLM_COMPILE","cudagraph_mode":"FULL_AND_PIECEWISE"}' --gpu-memory-utilization 0.85 \
  --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":5,"draft_sample_method":"probabilistic","rejection_sample_method":"block","enable_adaptive_verification":true}'
```

Load: closed-loop multi-turn chat, 96 concurrent streams, prompts 0.6K–118K tokens (~90% prefix-cache hits), outputs 8–5,000 tokens. The engine dies 30–60 s into the run, with ~90 requests running and the KV cache only ~3% used. We reproduced it 4 times in 4 tries across two nodes.

| Arm (same node, same load) | Result |
|---|---|
| adaptive verification **on**, `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` | IMA within 1 min at c96 (4/4) |
| adaptive verification **off**, `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` | stable: 30 min at c96 + 15 min at c128 |
| adaptive verification **on**, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` | stable: 15 min at c128 |

The fix only has to keep mixed/prefill batches out of FULL graphs while adaptive verification is on. That points at the same class as #59681 / #59751. In 0.31.0 the DSV4.1 FlashInfer sparse builders (`DeepseekV4FlashInferSparseMLAMetadataBuilder` and `DeepseekSparseSWAFlashInferMetadataBuilder` in `vllm/models/deepseek_v41/nvidia/flashinfer_sparse.py`, along with the compressor and FlashMLA builders) all declare `AttentionCGSupport.ALWAYS`. #59751 changes only the generic `FlashInferMLASparseTRTLLMMetadataBuilder`, so it will not cover this path. The likely fix is the same move for these builders: `UNIFORM_BATCH` plus `get_varlen_cudagraph_max_query_len` returning `max_decode_query_len(vllm_config)`.

Workaround: `enable_adaptive_verification: false`. Throughput was the same within noise (c128: 1,643 vs 1,608 out tok/s per GPU for on + `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`).

### Before submitting a new issue...

- [x] Searched existing issues (#59681 and #59751 are related, but they cover the generic backend and `cudagraph_mode=FULL`).
